turns.text: - Do you want me to come in there with you?
turns.zh: 你要我跟你一起进去吗？

turns.text: - No.
turns.zh: 不用。

turns.text: Oh, hey.
turns.zh: 哦，嘿。

turns.text: You're here to take my food order.
turns.zh: 你是来给我点餐的。

turns.text: Mr. Harkness, I'm Diana Tavener, second desk.
turns.zh: 哈克尼斯先生，我是戴安娜·塔弗纳，二桌的。

turns.text: I know who you are.
turns.zh: 我知道你是谁。

turns.text: You're here to take my food order.
turns.zh: 你是来给我点餐的。

turns.text: No, I'm not.
turns.zh: 不，我不是。

turns.text: No. Ow.
turns.zh: 不是。哎哟。

turns.text: And I don't see what else we have to talk about.
turns.zh: 而且我看不出我们还有什么好谈的。

turns.text: Are there any more of your assets in the field?
turns.zh: 你还有别的资产在外头吗？

turns.text: You mean any more bad guys out there? No.
turns.zh: 你是说外头还有没有别的坏蛋？没了。

turns.text: I'll be rebuilding.
turns.zh: 我会重建的。

turns.text: You know my son River, right?
turns.zh: 你认识我儿子里弗，对吧？

turns.text: Our paths have crossed. Yeah.
turns.zh: 我们打过照面。是啊。

turns.text: Well, I offered to take him off your hands.
turns.zh: 嗯，我提出过把他从你那儿接走。

turns.text: He's not a good fit in this organization.
turns.zh: 他在这个组织里不太合适。

turns.text: Hence his presence in that sewage farm of yours.
turns.zh: 所以他才待在你那个污水厂里。

turns.text: And I think I can make something of him.
turns.zh: 我觉得我能把他调教出个样子来。

turns.text: So if you want to fire him, I'd approve, you know, as his father,
turns.zh: 所以你要是想开除他，我会同意，你知道，作为他父亲，

turns.text: or as his prospective lawyer.
turns.zh: 或者作为他未来的律师。

turns.text: Mr. Hartnest,
turns.zh: 哈特内斯特先生，

turns.text: why can't you grasp that it's over for you?
turns.zh: 你怎么就不明白，你已经完了？

turns.text: Why can't you grasp that it's over for you? Well, forgive me, Miss Tavener,
turns.zh: 你怎么就不明白，你已经完了？好吧，恕我直言，塔弗纳小姐，

turns.text: but pretty soon you're about to find out that it's all starting all over for me.
turns.zh: 但很快你就会发现，对我来说一切才刚刚重新开始。

turns.text: I mean, granted, I didn't expect this little sojourn, but I left to fail safe.
turns.zh: 我是说，没错，我没料到会有这趟小逗留，但我留了后手。

turns.text: Never thought I'd have to use it, but needs must. No.
turns.zh: 从没想过会用上，但不得已就得用。不。

turns.text: I don't suppose I could get a steak.
turns.zh: 我想我能不能来块牛排。

turns.text: I need to eat before you let me go.
turns.zh: 你放我走之前我得吃点东西。

turns.text: - This interrogation is far from over.
turns.zh: 这场审讯还远没结束。

turns.text: - Oh, is that what this is?
turns.zh: 哦，这就是审讯啊？

turns.text: - What? Sorry to interrupt. Something has come up. - There you go.
turns.zh: 什么？抱歉打断一下。出了点事。— 给你。

turns.text: Shall I come out with you now?
turns.zh: 我现在跟你一起出去吗？

turns.text: (knocking]
turns.zh: （敲门声）

turns.text: You ever looking to go freelance?

turns.text: Give me a call.
turns.zh: 给我打电话。
